description: Create a non-custodial crypto payment session supporting Dual Checkout (Web3 1-Click Pay & Direct Transfer / QR from Binance/Bybit/OKX with on-chain explorer verification), multi-chain agnostic links, 1-year reusable payment links, and automated HTML invoice email delivery.

cancel_url.description: HTTPS redirect URL if customer cancels checkout.

coupon_code.description: Optional promotional discount coupon code to apply.

currency.description: Payment token symbol (e.g., USDT, USDC, SOL, TRX, BNB, ETH, MATIC).

customer_email.description: Buyer email address for invoice delivery and payment receipt notifications.

description.description: Human-readable order description shown on checkout and invoice.

ipn_callback_url.description: HTTPS webhook endpoint URL for HMAC-SHA256 signed payment lifecycle events.

is_multi_chain.description: When true, generates a universal multi-chain link allowing the buyer to dynamically choose their network and token at checkout.

is_reusable.description: When true, the payment link remains active for 1 year and accepts repeated payments.

network.description: Blockchain network key (e.g., tron-mainnet, bsc-mainnet, solana-mainnet, polygon-mainnet, base-mainnet, arc-mainnet, bsc-testnet). Optional if is_multi_chain is true.

order_id.description: Merchant internal order or invoice reference ID (e.g., ORD-1001).

send_invoice_email.description: When true and customer_email is provided, sends a branded responsive HTML invoice email with 1-click payment CTA.

success_url.description: HTTPS redirect URL after confirmed payment.

name: xpayr_create_payment_session
